content: Long lists on mobile web: prefer explicit pagination/load-more over infinite scroll for monitoring lists (predictable scroll position, refreshable); sticky search + filter chips above the list; virtualize only above hundreds of rows; overscroll-behavior-y contain/none disables native pull-to-refresh and scroll chaining (MDN verified) which matters when implementing custom pull-to-refresh or when nested scrollers (tree inside page) must not chain.
